categories.main_business_segments: Puyuan Precision Electric Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electronic measurement instruments industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of general electronic measurement instruments such as digital oscilloscopes, RF instruments, waveform generators, power supplies and electronic loads, multimeters, and data acquisition devices. The company also provides related technical and after-sales services, as well as computer hardware and software sales. It has expanded into modular instruments and integrated solutions, aiming to transform from a hardware-centric supplier to a comprehensive solutions provider.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes original technology innovation with proprietary core technologies in hardware, algorithms, and software. Key technologies include high-bandwidth, high-resolution oscilloscope analog front-end chips, high sampling rate data acquisition, high refresh rate display algorithms, and modular hardware platforms. Production methods combine in-house manufacturing of core components with outsourced non-critical parts, supported by advanced ERP, MES, and WMS systems to ensure quality and efficiency. The company also employs lean manufacturing and automation technologies such as AGV and robotic assembly lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Puyuan serves a diverse customer base across over 90 countries, including industries such as telecommunications, new energy, semiconductors, consumer electronics, industrial electronics, transportation, energy, education, scientific research, and system integration. Its products support scientific research, product development, and manufacturing testing, with strategic focus on emerging sectors like 5G, AI, IoT, semiconductor testing, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Suzhou, China, with R&D centers in Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, and overseas subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, Malaysia, and marketing representatives in India, Brazil, and Vietnam. Its sales and service network covers domestic Chinese markets and international markets including North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and emerging economies.
categories.supply_chain_position: Puyuan operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electronic measurement instrument supply chain. It focuses on R&D, manufacturing, and direct sales of finished electronic measurement products and solutions. The company controls core manufacturing processes internally, including packaging, testing, and assembly of key components, while outsourcing non-core parts. It manages a global supply chain with strategic supplier relationships and employs just-in-time and material requirements planning procurement methods.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic R&D priorities include advancing integrated circuit design, composite material processes, high-end manufacturing capabilities, and core hardware, algorithm, and software innovations. It focuses on high-bandwidth digital oscilloscopes, high-resolution instruments, modular instruments, and integrated solutions tailored for communication, semiconductor, and new energy sectors. Puyuan invests heavily in R&D, with over 26% of revenue allocated, and maintains multiple patent portfolios and industry standard contributions. Future R&D emphasizes AI-driven intelligent testing, modular platforms, and ecosystem co-development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of electronic measurement instruments and related solutions. Sales channels include direct sales to strategic and large customers, distributor sales, and e-commerce platforms. The company also earns revenue from after-sales services and technical support. It has recently expanded into solution sales and modular instrument platforms, which contribute a growing share of revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Puyuan ranks as the fifth largest global oscilloscope vendor and is the only Chinese company in the global top five. It holds a leading domestic position in digital oscilloscopes, waveform generators, and RF instruments, with competitive advantages in technology and cost. The company competes with international leaders from the US, Germany, and Japan, and is recognized for its innovation and patent portfolio. It is a member of key industry associations and standards committees, reinforcing its industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Puyuan achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 776 million, a 15.7% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 92.3 million. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.85 billion, growing nearly 18% from the previous year. R&D investment increased significantly to 26.64% of revenue. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding product lines and solution sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Puyuan emphasizes original technology innovation, high performance, and cost-effective electronic measurement instruments with advanced features such as high bandwidth (up to 13GHz), high vertical resolution (up to 12bit), and high sampling rates. Its modular instrument platforms and integrated solutions provide flexible, scalable, and efficient testing capabilities tailored to complex customer needs. The company’s strong patent portfolio, industry standard leadership, and global localized service network differentiate it as a trusted partner for scientific research and industrial testing in strategic emerging industries.
